theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : Nat.gcd (2 * n + 1) (n + 1) = 1 := by
  induction n with d hd
  · exact rfl
  · have h : Nat.gcd (2 * d + 1) (d + 1) = 1 := hd
    have h1 : Nat.gcd (2 * (d + 1) + 1) (d + 2) = 1 :=
      rw [Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_of_gcd_eq_gcd]
      exact h
    rw [Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_of_gcd_eq_gcd] at h1
    exact h1
